items.title: Zanana tolidi chakkar - menstrual cycle (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the menstrual cycle (PDF 79-80).

blocks.text: Zanana reproductive system chakkar daar (cyclic) waqiat se guzar kar kaam karta hai; in sab waqiat ko mila kar menstrual cycle (haiz ka chakkar) kehte hain. Menstrual cycle taqreeban ek mahina (ausatan 28 din) chalta hai aur ise in marahil (phases) mein baanta ja sakta hai:

Is phase mein endometrium ki functional layer jhar jati hai. Alag hua tissue aur khoon jism se bahar aate hain; isi ko menstruation (haiz) kehte hain. Yeh 3-5 din jari rehta hai. Yeh estrogen aur progesterone hormones ki kam miqdar ki wajah se hota hai. Is phase mein gonadotropins aur FSH barhna shuru ho jate hain (kitab ke alfaaz; FSH khud bhi ek gonadotropin hai).

FSH barhne se chand ovarian follicles barhna shuru karte hain, magar sirf ek follicle poora barhta hai aur baqi khatam (degenerate) ho jate hain. Yeh pakka hua follicle Graafian follicle kehlata hai aur ovary ki sateh par ubhar aata hai.

FSH Graafian follicle se estrogen hormones chhurwata hai. Estrogen endometrium mein khoon ki nalyan banana (vascularization) shuru karta hai aur use dobara makhmali (velvety) aur mota kar deta hai. Kitab ke mutabiq jaise jaise estrogen barhta hai, negative feedback se FSH girta hai, aur FSH girne ki wajah se anterior pituitary LH chhorta hai. Yeh proliferative phase ke aakhir (din 14) par hota hai. Anterior pituitary se LH ka achanak chhootna (LH surge) Graafian follicle se ovum ko oviduct mein chhurwata hai. Is phase ko ovulation kehte hain.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai estrogen barhne par FSH girta hai is liye LH chhoot'ta hai. Zyada tar hawalon ke mutabiq ovulation se zara pehle estrogen ki zyada aur musalsal satah hi LH ka ubhaar laati hai (pituitary par positive feedback), aur saath FSH ka chhota ubhaar hota hai. Khaaka yahi aam namoona dikhata hai.

blocks.alt: Ovary ki tarash, baen taraf se khoon ki nalyan dakhil hoti hain. Marahil ghari ki sui ki simt (clockwise) tarteeb mein, bahar teer: primary oocytes wale primary follicles, mae (fluid) wali jagah banate developing follicles, secondary oocyte wala bara Graafian follicle, phata hua (ruptured) follicle jis se released ovum ovary se nikalta hai, phir early corpus luteum, corpus luteum aur sukarta hua (regressed) corpus luteum.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.6: Menstrual cycle ke dauran ovary mein tabdeeliyan (kitab ki Figure 17.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ovary ke khaake ko oopar baen se shuru kar ke ghari ki sui ki simt parhein, bahar ke gulabi teeron ke saath. Chhota primary follicle barhta hai, us mein mae ki jagah banti hai aur woh Graafian follicle ban jata hai. Ovulation par Graafian follicle phat kar secondary oocyte (released ovum) bahar chhorta hai. Phata hua follicle LH ke asar se peela corpus luteum ban jata hai, jo estrogen aur progesterone banata hai. Fertilization na ho to corpus luteum sukar kar khatam (regressed) ho jata hai.

Ovulation ke baad LH phate hue Graafian follicle ko ek peeli (yellow) banawat mein badalta hai jise corpus luteum kehte hain. Corpus luteum estrogen aur progesterone hormones chhorta hai jo endometrium ko zyada khoon wala (vascular) aur glandular banate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein ek jagah “Copus luteum” chhapa hai; sahi naam corpus luteum hai.

blocks.title: For Information: menopause
blocks.text: Auraton mein taqreeban 50 saal ki umar mein menstrual cycle band ho jata hai; ise menopause kehte hain.

Agar fertilization na ho to corpus luteum khatam (degenerate) hona shuru ho jata hai. Kitab ke mutabiq is ke nateeje mein anterior pituitary LH chhorna band kar deta hai. Corpus luteum ke khatam hone se estrogen aur progesterone ki miqdar achanak gir jati hai. Is se moti endometrium khoon ke saath jhar jati hai, yani din 28 par menstruation hota hai (aur naya chakkar shuru hota hai).

blocks.title: For Information: hCG aur hamal ka test
blocks.text: Agar ovulate hua oocyte fertilize ho jaye to nanha embryo human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) chhorta hai. Yeh hormone corpus luteum ko qaim rakhta hai, is liye estrogen aur progesterone zyada rehte hain aur haiz nahin aata. hCG maa se nahin balke embryo ke chorion se aata hai, isi liye tamam pregnancy tests isi hormone ko check karte hain.

blocks.alt: Din 0 se 28 tak teen qataaron ka chart, menstrual phase, follicular phase, din 14 par ovulation aur secretory phase mein bata hua. Ovary: follicle barhta, ovulation par phat'ta, corpus luteum banta aur sukar jata hai. Hormones: FSH shuru mein barhta aur ovulation par chhota uchaal; estrogen ovulation se zara pehle aur phir din 21 ke qareeb uncha; LH din 13-14 par achanak uchaal; progesterone din 22 ke qareeb sab se ooncha. Endometrium: pehle dinon mein jharta, phir aakhir tak mota hota hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.7: Menstrual cycle (kitab ki Figure 17.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; 'Secretory' ki sahih spelling, menstrual phase din 5 tak).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chart ko oopar se neeche aik hi din par parhein: jaise din 14 par ovary mein follicle phat'ta hai, hormones mein LH ka uchaal hai aur endometrium mota ho raha hai. Kitab ki tasveer mein do ghaltiyan hain: aakhri hisse ka naam 'Secretary phase' chhapa hai, sahih 'Secretory phase' hai; aur menstrual phase ki lakeer din 4 par hai jabke kitab ka apna matn menstrual phase din 1 se 5 batata hai. Hamare khaake mein lakeer din 5 par hai. 'Follicular phase' ovary ka naam hai; rahim ke liye isi waqt ko proliferative phase kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Corpus luteum ka menstrual cycle mein kya kirdar hai, aur hamal mein ise kaun qaim rakhta hai?
blocks.explanation: Corpus luteum estrogen aur progesterone chhorta hai jo endometrium ko mota, khoon wala aur glandular rakhte hain. Fertilization na ho to yeh khatam ho jata hai aur haiz aata hai. Hamal mein embryo ka hCG ise qaim rakhta hai, is liye endometrium nahin jharti.

items: Din 1-5: menstrual phase, estrogen aur progesterone kam, endometrium ki functional layer jharti hai.
Din 6-14: FSH se Graafian follicle, estrogen se endometrium dobara moti; din 14 par LH ka achanak chhootna aur ovulation.
Din 15-28: LH se corpus luteum, estrogen aur progesterone; fertilization na ho to corpus luteum khatam, hormones girte hain aur din 28 par haiz.
Hamal mein embryo ka hCG corpus luteum ko qaim rakhta hai; taqreeban 50 saal par menopause.
